semantic_base: Verified original Japanese, English reference only
method: Direct handwritten Vietnamese after reading each selected event and branch; no MT or bulk pronoun replacement. Preserve faithful latest manual edits.
register: Menad em/ngài Rance; Rance ta/em and ta/cô with Kanami; Kanami tôi/anh with Rance, tớ/cậu with close friend Menad. Zarak hostile tao/mày after accusation. Maris thần/Bệ hạ to Rance, tôi/cô to Haurein. Barres cha/con; Haurein tôi/ngài in military address and con/cha in private. Fuuka tôi/ngài Rance; Rance ta/em or Fuuka.
source_decisions: Menad lover is not brother; do not confuse Rance and Zarak as the man treated as subordinate.
Rance’s command means return to military post, not article. Kanami descends from ceiling space, never falls to ground.

Menad’s VAR58-absent branch initially retains Maris portrait due original command stream; utterances clearly belong to Menad until Maris intervenes. Dialogue translated by actual speaker context, no command altered.
Fuuka つるべ well bucket and 桶 tub distinguished. Existing 年寄りに冷や水 literal-water pun retained.

Haurein 棒針 knitting needles, not crochet. Japanese says belly warmer because father has stomach trouble. Barres says a commander’s favoritism causes deaths, not that many commanders die. Existing correct Japanese-based passage retained.
